sourceText: Framework regression discovered 2026-07-14 while closing B-3b05: DONE-required npm test fails from every story worktree because doctor global-core-realpath falsely warns when a worktree-built CLI evaluates a fixture project, blowing the brief-output-smoke 20000-byte doctor budget (20239). Fix the check (canonicalize the non-self expected), not the budget.
normalizedOutcome: npm test green from story worktrees; doctor via worktree-built CLI on fixture projects shows no global-core-realpath false warn; genuine unrelated-path mismatch still warns; brief budget assertion passes in both contexts
acceptanceClaim: npm run test:brief-output passes from inside a story worktree (doctor brief under 20000 bytes with no global-core-realpath warn block), while a genuine global-CLI mismatch fixture still produces the warn
